The '''Majilop system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Majilop]].<ref name="GG11" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Majilop system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square Q-18.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
